mapper.select: select subscription_id, user_id, subscription_status, billing_anchor_day, current_cycle_start_at, current_cycle_end_at, next_billing_at, expected_next_amount, paused_at, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription where user_id = #{userId}

select subscription_item_id, subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, editable_after_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription_item where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'CURRENT' order by subscription_item_id

select subscription_item_id, subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, editable_after_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription_item where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'NEXT' order by subscription_item_id

select subscription_id, user_id, subscription_status, billing_anchor_day, current_cycle_start_at, current_cycle_end_at, next_billing_at, expected_next_amount, paused_at, cancelled_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}

select subscription_item_id, subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, effective_start_at, effective_end_at, editable_after_at, created_at, updated_at from subscription_item where subscription_item_id = #{subscriptionItemId} and plan_version = 'NEXT'
mapper.insert: insert into subscription_item ( subscription_id, capsule_product_id, plan_version, item_status, coverage_amount_snapshot, monthly_price_snapshot, created_at, updated_at ) select #{subscriptionId}, #{capsuleProductId}, 'NEXT', 'RESERVED_ADD', cp.coverage_amount, cp.monthly_price, now(), now() from capsule_product cp where cp.capsule_product_id = #{capsuleProductId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from subscription_item where subscription_id = #{subscriptionId} and plan_version = 'NEXT' and item_status = 'RESERVED_ADD'
